text:
- **Go pm replaces Python pm:** Both repos no longer contain Python pm, and the harness suite checks only Go pm. The pm-harness project now lives in Yeeef/pm, with its full history.
- **Records layout and pm commands:** Go pm no longer writes a records copy into main, and each worktree keeps its link. New commands move a sprint to another project and remove unneeded agent worktrees.
- **Release notes and CI:** The new pm release is published and carries a breaking change. Release notes now come from the changelog. CI refuses a pull request or release tag without a changelog section.
- **Site display and checks:** Diagrams redraw when the colour theme changes, and images from records now show on the site. The change check no longer fails when git rewrites a file mid-walk.
